purpose: Declarative contracts for runtime health, system observability, and model availability utilities.

tools.name: memory_health
tools.description: Check memory server health, storage reachability, and whether at least one enabled LLM provider is usable.

tools.name: system_info
tools.description: Get a full overview of the SloplessCode system: components, live counters, configured LLM providers, available models, and infrastructure status. Call this when you need to understand what the system can do or explain it to the user.

tools.name: model_available
tools.description: List available cloud models ranked by remaining quota capacity. Use before starting a long task to pick the model with most remaining budget. Optionally filter by task_type to see models capable of specific tasks.

tools.name: report_limit_hit
tools.description: Signal that a cloud model hit its rate/quota limit (429 or similar error). Triggers a cooldown period. Call this automatically when you receive a rate-limit error. After calling this, use model_available or route_task to find the next available model.

model_id.description: Cloud model id or component, e.g. claude-sonnet or gpt-4o

error_code.description: HTTP error code or API error code

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Check the status of a background job submitted via ?background=true. Returns status (queued/running/done/failed) and result when complete. Use after submitting project_ingest, project_refresh, or skills_retag in background mode.

job_id.description: Job ID returned by background submission
